datasets.name: ODSPolicy
datasets.sql:
select imp.rowid, imp.* from ins_med_policy imp
where 
imp.meds_id = :meds_id

datasets.name: ODSReport
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME,
       ic.address, 
       to_char(im.begindate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate, 
       to_char(im.enddate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') enddate,       
       im.empnum,
       LTRIM(TO_CHAR (ABS(ims.inssum), '99G999G999G999G999G999D99MI')||' '||v.val_name) as inssum,
       LTRIM(TO_CHAR (ABS(ics.ammount), '99G999G999G999G999G999D99MI')||' '||v.val_name) as insammountall,
       ims.insurancetime ||decode(ims.itspec, 'M', ' ay', 'Y', ' il')  as period,
       ics.ins_date as contractdate,
       imp.inscontract,
       ics.policy_num,
       LTRIM(TO_CHAR (ABS(imp.franshiz), '99G999G999G999G999G999D99MI')||' '||v.val_name) as franshiz,
       v.valu_name,
       sc.name as scname,
       ics.loanacc_id, ics.curracc_id, ics.ammount 
  FROM ins_med_policy imp,
       ins_med_suggestion ims,
       ins_customers ic,
       ins_medical im,
       ins_contracts ics,
       avalute v,
       ins_dict_spec_conditions sc
 WHERE ic.ID = im.kli_id AND im.ID = ims.med_id AND ims.ID = imp.meds_id
 and v.valute = ics.valute_id
 and ics.blank_id = im.id
 and imp.sc_id = sc.id(+)
 and imp.id = :mp_id

datasets.name: ODSSpecCond
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from INS_DICT_SPEC_CONDITIONS idr

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.sugg_id =:suggid
and type_id = 9
